text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: This must be a dream.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
However, even if it fades or loses its
luster, I must
never lose it.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
For my feelings are what breathe life
into this
dream world.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion returns without incident and
we begin the continuation of her
incredible three
years here. On one
particular day...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer! Traineeer! Over here!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, did I scare you? I planned the
perfect
surprise attack! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Are you free right now, Trainer? There's
a small
gathering that I'd like you to
accompany me to.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to introduce you, Your
Excellency. This
is my trainer from the
academy.

text_block_list.name: Irish Ambassador
text_block_list.text: A pleasure to make your acquaintance.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The ambassador was a good friend of my
father's while they were in university and
has been looking
out for me since I was
very young.

text_block_list.name: Irish Ambassador
text_block_list.text:
I must say, it brings me much pleasure to
see that
rambunctious young girl grown
into such a fine
lady.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but I'm still running around to this
day. ♪
And it's all thanks to you and the
others.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At that moment, I realize the person
standing before me is likely the person
who recommended
Fine Motion as a
Goodwill Ambassador.

text_block_list.name: Irish Ambassador
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. The embassy needed a Goodwill
Ambassador, so I merely suggested the best
candidate I had.
Your father agreed with my
sentiments.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...!
He did?

text_block_list.name: Irish Ambassador
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. He must have noticed just how
many
individuals in Japan wished for you
to take on
such a role.

text_block_list.name: Irish Ambassador
text_block_list.text:
Being posted here myself, I've heard no
shortage of good things about you. You
were recommended for the position by
your many
merits.

text_block_list.name: Irish Ambassador
text_block_list.text:
And word of those merits has certainly
made its way to Ireland. The president
and Taoiseach both
agreed that you
were an excellent fit.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you so much. Truly.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I can't help but laugh when I think back.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You were so on edge at the start of the
party, I
thought your eyes were going to
pop out of your
head.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? I thought the atmosphere was
rather
easygoing.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
There were so many people I wanted to
introduce you to, so I thought it would
be a great opportunity to do so in a
setting that wasn't
overly formal.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ehehe.
choice_data_list: It really showed how much everyone...
I could tell that you're loved

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You're right. I do seem to be quite
loved.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I have to consider my position.
Sometimes I can't
help but feel like...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Like they see the figure called "Fine
Motion," not
the person inside.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
But that was just in my head. Everyone
has always
been thinking about what's
best for me.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That makes me so happy. I'm truly
blessed...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if it's because I was able to
find
my lucky
clover.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes. By which I mean you, Trainer. So
many things
changed for me after I met
you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You recognized the real me—the me
who wished
to run and so led me to even
greater happiness.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Pardon?
choice_data_list: I appreciate the thought, but that...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
So you've finally returned! You're late,
Fine!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: We've been waiting for you!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Everyone... Wait, did I have some
appointment
with you all?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
What?! But this was your idea in the first
place!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Weren't you the one who said you
wanted to run
together now that you're
back?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, was that today?! It completely
slipped my
mind!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What else is new?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'm surprised you manage to stay on top
of your
official duties, princess.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Shakur! You're here too?!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Like I'd let a chance to collect this much
data slip
away from me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I see even more people coming our
way... Just
how many people did you
invite?!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: On that note, hurry up and get ready.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The road ahead's a bit different from
what you're
used to... So enjoy it, Fine.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...What a surprise. I know I made plans
with
everyone, but I can't believe how
many people
showed up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All the Umamusume gathered here today have
been captivated by Fine
Motion's running—and
the power she
possesses inside of her.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That is the highest praise you could give
me. ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Well, I ought to get going—to the place
where I
belong!
